path_decisions.rationale: Signal strength is hardcoded per strategy, never calibrated to actual condition count or quality; consolidation uses default hit_rates=0.5 — entry signal strength is effectively disconnected from real calibration
Calibration gap cascades: uncalibrated signals feed into profit_target_exit which is long-only and uses averaged RSI adaptation instead of per-entry RSI
Profit target defaults are likely wrong because min_conditions gating is miscalibrated — mean_rev volume_threshold=0.8 trivially satisfied, vol_breakout min_conditions=5 nearly impossible
Miscalibrated entries feed into risk/position sizing which has its own bugs: strategy_budget sums ALL positions not per-strategy, strategy_win_rates never populated

candidate_solution.summary: 6 bottlenecks found: hardcoded signal strength, dead consolidation, long-only profit_target_exit, trivial min_conditions in mean_rev, strategy_budget bug sums all positions, strategy_win_rates never wired

bottlenecks.title: Signal strength hardcoded, never varies with condition count
bottlenecks.fix: Compute strength = conditions_met / total_conditions for each strategy, normalized to [0,1]

bottlenecks.title: consolidate_signals() and strategy_hit_rates never wired into TradingSession
evidence: generator.py:69 default hit_rates=0.5 for unknown strategies
bottlenecks.fix: Wire consolidate_signals() into signal pipeline; feed backtest-derived strategy_win_rates into PositionSizer and RiskEngine

bottlenecks.title: profit_target_exit() long-only bug confirmed; RSI-adaptive uses global avg not per-entry
evidence: _runtime.py:167 target = entry_price * (1 + profit_take_pct); check close >= target — LONG only
trend_following.py:260-265 rsi_at_entry = rsi[entries]; avg_entry_rsi = float(rsi_at_entry.mean()) — averages ALL entries, not current trade
mean_reversion.py:107-109 on_bar() exit has no profit_target or max_holding check
volatility_breakout.py:391 highest tracks only highest, never lowest for shorts
bottlenecks.fix: Add direction parameter to profit_target_exit(); use per-trade RSI instead of global average; add profit_target to mean_reversion on_bar()

bottlenecks.title: Mean_rev volume_threshold=0.8 trivially satisfied; vol_breakout min_conditions=5 too restrictive
evidence: mean_reversion.py:37 self._volume_threshold = p.get('volume_threshold', 0.8) — 0.8 means vol > 80% of MA, nearly always true
mean_reversion.py:99 long_count = int(vol_ok) + int(rsi<oversold) + int(close<bb_lower) — vol_ok ~always True, effective min_conditions = 1 of 2
volatility_breakout.py:48 self._min_conditions = p.get('min_conditions', 5) — ALL 5 conditions required
YAML sets volume_threshold=1.2 for mean_reversion but code default=0.8 wins
bottlenecks.fix: Fix YAML-key-to-code-key mapping; raise code default volume_threshold to match YAML; tune min_conditions to 3-4 for vol_breakout

bottlenecks.title: _check_strategy_budget sums ALL positions, not same-strategy positions
evidence: risk_engine.py:106-108 strategy_exposure = 0.0; for pos in portfolio.positions.values(): pos_value = abs(pos.quantity) * pos.current_price; strategy_exposure += pos_value — sums ALL positions regardless of strategy_id
bottlenecks.fix: Filter positions by strategy_id match; Position model needs strategy_id field

bottlenecks.title: YAML config keys don't match code param names — dead config values
evidence: mean_reversion.yaml:19 trailing_stop_pct: 0.02 — not read by any code
bottlenecks.fix: Align YAML key names with code param names; add config-loading bridge in strategy __init__

evidence_anchors: trend_following.py:260-265 — rsi[entries].mean() global avg not per-trade
risk_engine.py:106-108 — sums all positions not per-strategy
engine.py:54 — RiskEngine/PositionSizer never receive per-strategy data
mean_reversion.yaml:17 vs mean_reversion.py:40 — key name mismatch
notes: Iteration 1 found the long-only profit_target bug and trailing stop issues. This iteration traced the full chain from signal generation through calibration, profit targets, entry gating, to risk/position sizing — finding that the signal pipeline is fundamentally disconnected: hardcoded strengths, unwired consolidation, dead config values, and budget check bugs mean the post-implementation system still has systematic gaps preventing 65%+ win rate.
